answer_1.quote: We choose the text-to-SQL task to test LLMs' ability to handle novel interpretations because of its relevance to real-world applications... We create MAGNIFICO by modifying and re-tasking examples from an existing text-to-SQL benchmark, Spider.

answer_2.quote: The metric for evaluating the generated SQL queries in text2SQL benchmarks is execution accuracy... We use a metric called Relative Performance which is derived from execution accuracy on novel‑interpretation examples and base examples.
